defect.description: The setting is read as settings['FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE'] or False instead of settings.getbool(...): command-line overrides arrive as text, so -s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=False (or =0) gives the non-empty string 'False', which is truthy and turns active mode on.

review_items: CLI string 'false' enables active mode because from_settings does not coerce strings to bool
No test verifies store() calls ftp.set_pasv(False) when active
No test exercises Settings.from_command_line() string path, missing coercion bug
from_settings bypasses Settings.getbool() with raw access and 'or False'
'or False' fallback is dead code given DEFAULTS entry
store() leaks FTP connection on exception before quit()
from_settings reads active but not port/username/password from settings
votes.evidence_quote: User runs with -s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=false; from_command_line stores the string "false"; settings["FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE"] returns "false"; "false" or False evaluates to the truthy string "false"; if self.active: on line 34 is True; ftp.set_pasv(False) executes and active mode is enabled despite the user requesting passive mode. Should use settings.getbool("FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE").
votes.justification: The review names the exact defect in from_settings: a CLI string 'false' is truthy, so the `or False` expression turns active mode on. It also gives settings.getbool() as the fix.
